title: CTAB-Beads: HMW DNA Extraction Protocol Using MagAttract and E.Z.N.A. Kits
author: Simona Buonanno

steps.title: Transfer and grind sample
steps.instruction: Working on dry ice, transfer the arthropod sample (40–60 mg) into a sterile pre‑chilled 1.5 mL BM tube. If the sample has a hard exoskeleton, break it with pre‑chilled sterile scissors or tweezers, then grind with a pre‑chilled BM pestle (manual or PWM) using 2–4 s pulses while monitoring disruption. Position the sample between tube wall and pestle for efficient grinding. If grinding remains insufficient after repeated attempts, proceed to the next step; otherwise continue.

steps.title: Warm sample briefly
steps.instruction: Place the tube on normal ice and let the sample warm for 30 seconds to 1 minute.

steps.title: Add RNase A
steps.instruction: Add 4 µL RNase A (100 mg mL⁻¹) to the tube, flick to mix, and incubate for 2 minutes at room temperature (or 25 °C in a thermomixer).

steps.title: Add MagAttract suspension
steps.instruction: Add 40 µL MagAttract Suspension G (pre‑vortexed for 3 minutes) to the sample. Ensure magnetic particles are fully resuspended by gentle tapping; do not invert.

steps.title: Add Buffer MB
steps.instruction: Add 280 µL Buffer MB to the tube and mix gently.

steps.title: Add Buffer AL
steps.instruction: Add 150 µL Buffer AL (viscous) and mix by pipetting up and down with a wide‑bore tip.

steps.title: Vortex suspension
steps.instruction: Vortex the tube at maximum speed for 3 minutes to resuspend the MagAttract particles thoroughly.

steps.title: Incubate mixture
steps.instruction: Incubate the tube in a mixer at room temperature (or 25 °C) for 3 minutes at 1400 rpm.

steps.title: Magnetic bead separation 1
steps.instruction: Place the tube on a magnetic base (no centrifugation), wait 2 minutes until beads collect, then carefully remove and discard the supernatant without disturbing the bead pellet.

steps.title: Rinse beads with water
steps.instruction: While the tube remains on the magnetic base, add 700 µL distilled water, incubate 1 minute at room temperature, then remove the supernatant (save at 4 °C). Do not pipet water directly onto the bead pellet; instead, dispense against the tube wall opposite the pellet.

steps.title: Wash beads with Buffer PE
steps.instruction: Add 700 µL Buffer PE to the bead pellet, place the tube on the magnetic base, incubate 2 minutes at room temperature while mixing at 1400 rpm, then remove all supernatant. Use a small tip to remove any residual Buffer PE.

steps.title: Magnetic bead separation 2
steps.instruction: Without spinning, place the tube on the magnetic base, wait 2 minutes for bead separation, and discard the supernatant.

steps.title: Incubate beads with Buffer PE
steps.instruction: Repeat the previous Buffer PE incubation, but extend the mixing time to 30 minutes at room temperature while shaking at 1400 rpm.

steps.title: First DNA elution
steps.instruction: Place the tube on the magnetic base, wait 2 minutes, then transfer the supernatant (containing HMW DNA) to a new clean tube.

steps.title: Add Buffer AE and incubate
steps.instruction: Remove the tube from the magnetic base, add 50–150 µL Buffer AE pre‑heated to 55 °C, place on the mixer, and incubate 10 minutes at room temperature while shaking at 1400 rpm.

steps.title: Second DNA elution
steps.instruction: Repeat the magnetic separation (step 14) to collect a second eluate of HMW DNA.

steps.title: Overnight incubation
steps.instruction: Incubate both eluates at room temperature overnight to improve homogeneity.

steps.title: Optional third elution
steps.instruction: If desired, add 50 µL Buffer AE pre‑heated to 55 °C, incubate 10 minutes at room temperature while shaking at 1400 rpm, and collect any residual DNA.

steps.title: Post‑incubation homogenization
steps.instruction: After the overnight incubation, gently pipette‑mix the DNA 5 times with a P200 wide‑bore tip, then 5 times with a standard P200 tip. Incubate at 37 °C for 30 minutes, and finally pipette‑mix 5 more times with a standard P200 tip.

steps.title: Quantify DNA with Qubit
steps.instruction: Measure DNA concentration using a Qubit fluorometer with the High Sensitivity or Broad Range dsDNA assay. Use 1 µL of undiluted sample or a 1:5 dilution depending on expected concentration.

steps.title: Assess fragment distribution
steps.instruction: Run the DNA on an Agilent Femto Pulse (for fragments >40–50 kb) or a Fragment Analyzer (for fragments <50 kb) using the ProSize software to obtain size distribution, total concentration, average size, and quality metrics.

steps.title: Measure purity with NanoDrop
steps.instruction: Determine A260/A280 (acceptable range 1.8–2.0) and A260/A230 (acceptable range 2.0–2.3) ratios using a NanoDrop. The NanoDrop concentration should be similar to, or only slightly higher than, the Qubit value; values >2‑fold higher suggest contaminants.

steps.title: Transfer upper aqueous phase
steps.instruction: Using a wide‑bore tip, carefully transfer the upper aqueous phase to a clean 2 mL microcentrifuge tube, avoiding the milky interphase. If the aqueous phase is very small, add 200 µL ML1 Buffer, invert gently 20 times, then repeat centrifugation and transfer.

steps.title: Centrifuge sample
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the tube at 10 000 × g for 2 minutes at room temperature.

steps.title: Incubate at 60 °C
steps.instruction: Incubate the tube at 60 °C while shaking at 300 rpm for up to 3 hours (or until fully dissolved). Minimum 30 minutes, maximum ~4 hours; alternatively, incubate overnight at 37 °C.

steps.title: Add ML1 buffer and Proteinase K
steps.instruction: Add 350 µL ML1 Buffer and 25 µL Proteinase K solution. If the sample is still heterogeneous, continue grinding in the lysis buffer (ML1 + Proteinase K) manually or with the PWM until homogeneous.

steps.title: Transfer to 2 mL tube and mix
steps.instruction: Move the lysate into a 2 mL tube using a wide‑bore tip, then invert gently 20 times to mix thoroughly (the round‑bottom shape aids Proteinase K action).

steps.title: Add chloroform‑isoamyl alcohol
steps.instruction: Add 350 µL chloroform:isoamyl alcohol (24:1, v/v) and invert gently 20 times to mix.

steps.title: Repeat ML1/Proteinase K wash
steps.instruction: Repeat the addition of 350 µL ML1 Buffer and 25 µL Proteinase K, followed by transfer to a 2 mL tube and 20 gentle inversions, to perform a second wash.

steps.title: Add Buffer PE to beads
steps.instruction: Remove the tube from the magnetic base, add 700 µL Buffer PE directly onto the bead pellet, place on the mixer, and incubate at room temperature for 2 minutes while shaking at 1400 rpm.

steps.title: Add Buffer MW1 to beads
steps.instruction: Remove the tube from the magnetic base, add 700 µL Buffer MW1 directly onto the bead pellet, place on the mixer, and incubate at room temperature for 2 minutes at 1400 rpm.

steps.title: Second Buffer MW1 elution
steps.instruction: Repeat the previous Buffer MW1 step to collect a second eluate in a new tube (or the same tube, depending on expected yield).
